- Inspect and replace bearing / re-balance rotor (target: vibration_mm_s, est. RUL gain ~42.0 cycles, $1200, 6.0h downtime) — vibration_mm_s accounts for the largest health loss (loss=0.764, z=26.415).
- Reduce load by 15% until maintenance window (target: load_pct, est. RUL gain ~12.0 cycles, $0, 0.0h downtime) — Lower load slows degradation progression with no downtime; it buys time, it does not fix the fault.
